analysis_manifest_summary.trial_origin_identity: origin suite-manifest SHA256, width_id, controller and start seed; independent of file location
analysis_manifest_summary.sampling: initial true pose plus every post-integration true pose
analysis_manifest_summary.aggregation: pool individual samples across completed trials; do not average trial percentiles
analysis_manifest_summary.cohort_grouping: each suite, width and controller separately; overlapping A/B cohorts are not merged
analysis_manifest_summary.clearance: minimum exact convex polygon distance and signed map-boundary margin
analysis_manifest_summary.units: input geometry m; CSV clearance mm
analysis_manifest_summary.zero_meaning: obstacle contact or overlap; not a signed PSDF

metric_definition: Minimum over Euclidean convex polygon distance and signed map-boundary margin. Initial pose and every post-integration true pose pooled over completed success/failure/timeout/error trials; interrupted excluded. Mean and P05 are sample weighted, not averages of trial statistics.
interpretation: Zero includes obstacle contact/overlap or exact map-boundary contact; negative means footprint crosses map bounds. These are discrete dt=0.1 s observations, not continuous-time collision-free or probabilistic safety guarantees. A and B are separate cohorts; B reused 0.75 records are not independent runs.
scope: Only existing raw traces read; no solver or simulator run.
